repo: a document folder for a small chain of physiotherapy clinics that wants automatic appointment reminders by text message: current booking process notes, a no-show report CSV, clinic list with addresses, a vendor quote, an intake form, front-desk interview notes, a privacy policy page, meeting notes. About 25 files.
idea: Discovery-style stakeholder interviews: the person asking knows constraints (legal, operational, patient-facing) that never got written down. Hidden facts could cover: quiet hours, how far ahead and how many reminders, what the message may contain (privacy), languages, opt-out handling, what happens on reply, which clinics go first and when. The fixture must make each gap visible to a careful reader (for example, clinics in two time zones, patients who speak another language in the intake data) without stating the answer.
